class.name: MediaBrowser
class.brief_description: Lists SMB shares and folders, and local folders, for a file browser.

method.name: disconnect_host
method.description: Closes the kept connection, if any.

method.name: find_subtitles
method.description: Returns the subtitle files for a video (a local path or smb://), blocking like [method list_dir]: in the video's folder, those whose name starts with the video's name (all of them if it is the only video there), and those in a Subs, Sub, Subtitles or Subtitle folder next to it, and in that folder's subfolder named like the video (series packs). One Dictionary each: [code]path[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]language[/code], [code]language_name[/code], [code]forced[/code], [code]hearing_impaired[/code], [code]format[/code], [code]matches_video[/code] (see [method parse_subtitle_name]); those named after the video first. Load them with [method MediaSource.add_external_subtitle].

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Why the last call returned nothing, as a sentence for the user: for example "Access denied: HOST refused the user name or password.", "Access denied: no user name and password are set for HOST (set_smb_credentials() with this host name), and it refused a guest login.", "HOST has no share named \"X\".", "Not found: share/folder on HOST.", "Can't reach HOST: connection refused (is file sharing on, and port 445 open?).", "No answer from HOST within 8 s.", "Can't find the host NAME: the name doesn't resolve.". Empty after a call that succeeded (an empty folder is not an error). Never contains the password.

method.name: list_dir
method.description: Returns one Dictionary per entry: [code]name[/code], [code]is_dir[/code], [code]size[/code] (bytes; 0 for folders), [code]mtime[/code] (Unix time). Folders first, then by name in natural order, ignoring case; no [code].[/code] and [code]..[/code], no names starting with a dot unless [member include_hidden]. For [code]smb://host[/code], the host's shares as folders (see [method list_shares]). Empty on an error: see [method get_last_error].

method.name: list_shares
method.description: Returns the names of the host's shared folders, sorted: no printers, no IPC$, no hidden or administrative shares (names ending in [code]$[/code]). Uses the server service over DCE/RPC on IPC$. Some servers or policies don't allow listing shares; then the result is empty and [method get_last_error] says so, and the user has to type the share name.

method.name: parse_subtitle_name
method.description: Returns what a subtitle file's name says next to a video file (both names without folders): [code]subtitle[/code] (.srt, .ass, .ssa or .vtt), [code]matches_video[/code] (the name starts with the video's name without its extension, ignoring case), [code]language[/code] (normalized as by [method MediaSource.normalize_language]; the last language named wins, so [code]Film.en.srt[/code], [code]Film.English.srt[/code], [code]2_English.srt[/code] and [code]Film.pt-BR.srt[/code] work; empty if none), [code]language_name[/code], [code]forced[/code] ("forced", "foreign"), [code]hearing_impaired[/code] ("sdh", "cc", "hearing", or "hi" after a language: [code]Film.en.hi.srt[/code]; [code]Film.hi.srt[/code] is Hindi) and [code]format[/code] ("srt", "ass", "vtt").

method.name: read_file
method.description: Returns a whole file (a local path, res://, user://, or smb:// with the credentials of [method set_smb_credentials]), blocking like [method list_dir]: for cover pictures and other small files on a share. A file over 64 MiB, or one that can't be read, gives an empty array, and [method get_last_error] says why.

method.name: set_smb_credentials
method.description: Sets the credentials for [param host] (as it appears in paths; not case-sensitive), for [MediaBrowser] and [MediaSource] alike (it is the same as [method MediaSource.set_smb_credentials]). [param domain] is the host's computer name or workgroup for a local account, or empty. An empty user and password remove the entry. The password is kept in memory only, and never logged. A connection already open keeps the credentials it logged in with: call [method disconnect_host] after changing them.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], [method list_dir] also lists names that start with a dot.
Seconds to wait for each step (connect, log in, list) before giving up with "No answer from HOST".
